SCIM.TITLE: Directory sync (SCIM)
SCIM.DESCRIPTION: Your identity provider adds people to this workspace, deactivates them when they leave and sets their role from their groups. Only addresses on your verified domains are synced.
SCIM.NOT_ENABLED: Directory sync is not enabled on this instance. The operator turns it on (SSO_ENABLED and SCIM_WEBHOOK_URL, see docs/sso.md).
SCIM.NOT_CONFIGURED: Directory sync needs single sign-on, which is switched on but not fully set up on this instance yet. Ask the administrator or support team of this instance to finish the setup.
SCIM.OWNER_ONLY: Only a workspace owner can change directory sync. You can see its status.
SCIM.CREDENTIALS_NOTICE: Enter these in your identity provider's SCIM provisioning settings now. The token is shown only once: if you lose it, rotate it.
SCIM.VERIFY_DOMAIN_FIRST: Verify an email domain first: the directory only provisions addresses on your verified domains.

RESYNC_ERRORS.scim_unavailable: the directory service was not reachable.
RESYNC_ERRORS.auth_unavailable: the account service was not reachable; some people were skipped.
RESYNC_ERRORS.mass_deprovision_refused: it would have deactivated too many members at once, so nothing was changed. Check your identity provider, then resync (you can force it).
RESYNC_ERRORS.resync_failed: something went wrong; it is retried tonight.

SCIM.STALE_DIRECTORY: The directory before the last rotation could not be deleted yet, so its old token may still be accepted. It is retried with every resync.
SCIM.ROTATION_GRACE: Token rotated: until {{time}} a resync deactivates nobody, while your identity provider sends everyone to the new directory.
SCIM.TOKEN_HINT: The bearer token was shown when the directory was created; rotate it if you need a new one.
SCIM.GROUPS_DESCRIPTION: Give a group a workspace role; someone in several groups gets the highest. People in no mapped group get the role for new members ({{role}}, under Policy). The billing owner is never changed, owners' roles are never changed, and the role of members you invited by hand is left alone.
SCIM.NO_GROUPS: No groups yet. Assign groups to the SCIM app at your identity provider (push groups).
SCIM.CHECK_ROLE_HINT: After the token rotation several earlier groups had this name, so its role was not carried over. Choose it again.
SCIM.CONFIRM_ROTATE: Rotate the SCIM token? The base URL and the token both change, and the current token stops working at once. You then enter the new ones at your identity provider, which sends its users and groups again. Members keep their access meanwhile.
SCIM.ROTATE_STALE: The previous directory could not be deleted yet, so its token may still be accepted. Retry the clean-up below.
SCIM.CONFIRM_DELETE: Delete the directory? Members stay in the workspace with their current role, but your identity provider no longer adds, deactivates or updates them. People it had deactivated are enabled again where a seat is free; the others stay deactivated. Remove the SCIM app at your identity provider too.
SCIM.DELETED_LEFT: Directory deleted. Members were kept; {{count}} deactivated by it stay deactivated because no seat is free.
SCIM.CONFIRM_FORCE: This resync would deactivate {{count}} of {{total}} members, more than the safety limit, so nothing was changed. Check your identity provider's assignments first. Deactivate them anyway?
SCIM.CLEANUP_FAILED: The previous directory could not be deleted yet.

RESPONSE_EXPORT.PREPARING: We're preparing your export. This can take a few minutes. You can leave this page open or come back later; it will be waiting here.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.READY_UNTIL: The file is kept until {{time}} and you can download it as often as you like until then.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_RATE_LIMITED: You exported this form too often. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_IN_PROGRESS: An export of this form is already being prepared.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_TOO_MANY: This form has more responses than one export can hold (100,000). Narrow the list with the filters or a search, then export again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to export these responses.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_FAILED: The export could not be prepared. Nothing was kept. Try again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_DELETED: Responses were deleted while your export was being prepared, so we threw the file away. Start the export again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_PERMISSION: You can no longer export this form's responses.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_TOO_LARGE: The export is too large for one file. Narrow the list with the filters or a search, then export again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_GONE: This export is no longer available. Start it again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_GENERIC: The export did not work. Try again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_READY: You already have an export of this form ready. Download it, or delete the file to start a new one.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_BUSY: Several exports of this workspace are being prepared. Try again in a few minutes.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.ERROR_EXPORT_BUSY: You already have exports of this workspace running. Try again when one has finished.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.DOWNLOADED_STAYS: Downloaded. The file stays on our servers until {{time}}, so you can download it again.
RESPONSE_EXPORT.DISCARDED: The file was deleted from our servers. You can start a new export.

RESPONSES_LIST.NONE_MATCH_BODY: Try a wider date range, or clear a filter.
RESPONSES_LIST.LAST_UNAVAILABLE: The last page is not available for more than 10,000 responses. Sort the other way to see the other end.
RESPONSES_LIST.TOO_DEEP_TITLE: That page is too far to open directly
RESPONSES_LIST.TOO_DEEP_BODY: Move through the list with the pager, or start from the first page.

RESPONSES_STAFF.SEARCH_LABEL_DELETION: Search deletion requests by responder email
RESPONSES_STAFF.ERROR_BODY: Something went wrong, or you may not have access. Your responses are not affected.
RESPONSES_STAFF.NO_MATCH_BODY: Nothing matches “{{search}}”. The search looks at the responder's email address; anonymous responses cannot be found by it.
RESPONSES_STAFF.EMPTY_BODY: Responses appear here as soon as someone fills out your form.
RESPONSES_STAFF.EMPTY_DELETION_BODY: When a responder asks for their response to be deleted, it shows up here for you to act on.
RESPONSES_STAFF.TOOLBAR: Search, filter, sort and export responses

RESPONSE_PAGE.FORBIDDEN_TITLE: You do not have access to this response
RESPONSE_PAGE.FORBIDDEN_BODY: Reading responses needs the response.read permission in this workspace. Ask the workspace owner if you need it.
RESPONSE_PAGE.MISSING_BODY: It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
RESPONSE_PAGE.ERROR_BODY: Something went wrong while loading it. The response itself is not affected.
RESPONSE_PAGE.SKIPPED_NOTE: Skipped: this respondent's answers sent them past this page.
RESPONSE_PAGE.SKIPPED_NOTE_KEPT: Skipped: this respondent's answers sent them past this page. Answers given here before they changed course are still stored, and shown below.
RESPONSE_PAGE.SHOW_QUESTIONS_one: Show the {{count}} question on this page
RESPONSE_PAGE.SHOW_QUESTIONS_other: Show the {{count}} questions on this page
RESPONSE_PAGE.SHOW_QUESTIONS_ANSWERED_one: Show the {{count}} question on this page ({{answered}} answered)
RESPONSE_PAGE.SHOW_QUESTIONS_ANSWERED_other: Show the {{count}} questions on this page ({{answered}} answered)
RESPONSE_PAGE.CALCULATED_SKIPPED: Calculated, on a page the respondent skipped
RESPONSE_PAGE.CALCULATED_STAFF: Calculated for staff; kept from the respondent.
RESPONSE_PAGE.UNREADABLE_TITLE: This response could not be decrypted
RESPONSE_PAGE.UNREADABLE_TITLE_PARTS: Some data in this response could not be decrypted
RESPONSE_PAGE.UNREADABLE_BODY: The stored data is not readable ({{parts}}). It is not shown as empty answers.
RESPONSE_PAGE.DELETE_BODY: The response and any uploaded files are removed and can't be recovered. If the responder asked for this deletion, their request is marked as completed.
RESPONSE_PAGE.DELETE_FAILED: Could not delete the response. Try again.

RESPONSE_TEAM.INTERNAL_NOTE: Respondents never see these fields or their values.
RESPONSE_TEAM.INTERNAL_REQUIRED_TITLE: Required for your team, not for respondents
RESPONSE_TEAM.INTERNAL_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the internal fields
RESPONSE_TEAM.INTERNAL_CLASH_one: {{fields}} was just changed by another team member. Review and save again.
RESPONSE_TEAM.INTERNAL_CLASH_other: {{fields}} were just changed by another team member. Review and save again.
RESPONSE_TEAM.FEEDBACK_NOTE: The respondent sees these updates, signed with your organisation's name.
RESPONSE_TEAM.FEEDBACK_NOTIFIES: The respondent gets an email that there is an update, with a link — never the update itself.
RESPONSE_TEAM.FEEDBACK_NOT_NOTIFIED: The respondent is not emailed: they see this on their submission page, with their submission number.
RESPONSE_TEAM.FEEDBACK_READ_ONLY: Your role can read updates but not send them.
RESPONSE_TEAM.FEEDBACK_SENT_NOTIFIED: Update sent. The respondent will get an email notice.
